market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Dow -500 on Iran conflict; oil at $100 creates inflation overhang. PPI/CPI this week is the pivotal catalyst. Expect elevated VIX, sector rotation into energy/defense, and tech volatility. Crypto choppy on Kraken stress vs. golden cross signal.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle (compute, HBM, infrastructure) provides multi-year earnings visibility. Space policy tailwind emerging. However, sustained oil above $95 and trade war escalation could compress global growth. Favor quality, pricing power, and AI-exposed names over cyclical consumer.
